401913646.summary: Gane's technical striking, size advantage, and experience edge Hokit despite the latter's perfect record, but the -205 price is steep for a 36-year-old against an undefeated prospect with recent top-tier wins.

Chiasson's 35 years old with negative record momentum; Mesquita same age but peaking with 5 consecutive wins

Moneyline odds justify the pick but -220 creates insufficient value for parlays given only 141 days rest for Mesquita

401922646.summary: Diaz has superior recent form and a perfect five-fight streak against a chinny opponent coming off a draw, but the matchup lacks decisive edge and Yañez's power remains a real threat.

Johnson's finish rate (7 KOs, 1 sub in 9 wins) versus Almeida's declining output and 2 decision losses in last 5 fights
Moneyline price of -170 is fair but heavy, limiting parlay value

401931774.summary: Costa's recent form, youth, reach advantage and mixed martial arts base favor him over the aging, inconsistent Gordon, but the -375 price is steep for a fighter who just lost to a top contender and carries finish risk.

401913646.summary: Gane's technical striking, size advantage, and experience edge Hokit despite the latter's perfect record, but the -205 price is steep for a 36-year-old against an undefeated prospect with recent top-tier wins.
reasons: Gane's 8-inch reach advantage and striker pedigree should control distance against Hokit's limited fight history
Hokit's 10-0 record includes only one decision; Gane's recent KO of Pereira and pattern of finishing suggest ko is viable method
Gane is 36 and coming off a no-contest with Aspinall; Hokit's 146-day rest and unbeaten momentum create upset risk that -205 undervalues

401913647.summary: Thompson's superior striking pedigree and reach advantage should control this welterweight bout, but his age, recent losses, and Radtke's finishing power make this a coin flip masked by modest Thompson odds.
reasons: Thompson's 75-inch reach and kickboxing base give him 3-inch reach and stylistic advantages over Radtke's thugjitsu approach
Both fighters show comparable finisher rates but Thompson's last three losses came via KO/sub, suggesting defensive vulnerabilities that Radtke's 5 KO wins coul
Thompson is 43 with 483 days layoff after three straight losses; Radtke at 36 is fresher with a win in his last outing, negating age as a clear edge
Thompson favored at -130 reflects market respect for his name and skillset, but the price doesn't compensate for physical decline and momentum deficit

401922638.summary: Harrison's submission prowess and recent form edge Nunes' aging frame, but Nunes' striking and experience keep this competitive; the moneyline price doesn't justify parlay use.
reasons: Harrison is 8 submissions in 19 wins vs Nunes' 4 in 28, and grappling leverage favors the judo specialist
Nunes hasn't fought in 3.4 years at age 38; Harrison fought 1.4 years ago and is sharper
Nunes' last two wins came by decision against Peña after a submission loss to her, suggesting declining finishing ability
Harrison beat Peña by submission R2 while Nunes struggled; head-to-head recent form favors B

401922639.summary: Borralho's technical striking and grappling should control Belgaroui's raw power, but Belgaroui's recent KO streak and height advantage create genuine finish risk that makes the -150 favourite unsafe for parlays.
reasons: Borralho wins by decision in his last three fights; Belgaroui has zero submission losses but all three losses go to the cards, suggesting vulnerability to point
Belgaroui's 4-inch reach advantage and recent KO power (9 KOs in 11 wins) present real threat despite Borralho's superior fight IQ and 245-day layoff is only mo
Price of -150 is fair value but not generous; Belgaroui's 57-day recency and aggressive style create unpredictability that penalizes heavy parlay stacking

401922640.summary: Medić's recent knockout streak and fresher timing edge Holland's inconsistent form, but the price is steep for a welterweight with limited sample size.
reasons: Medić is 3-0 KO/TKO in last three fights versus Holland's mixed results; Holland has lost three straight decisions
Holland's record shows he loses to decision often (9 dec losses) and rarely gets finished, making him defensively sound but offering poor odds for a finisher be
Medić is only 99 days removed from last fight versus Holland's 210, suggesting sharper timing, but his 14-3 record and limited high-level opposition create fini
The moneyline at -170 inflates risk for a middling favorite in a three-round format where chaos can occur

401922641.summary: Hasan's undefeated record, recent finishing power, youth, reach advantage, and fresh legs make him the clear choice, but the -900 moneyline carries too much chalk risk for parlay construction.
reasons: Hasan is 10-0 with 8 KOs in 10 fights; Gurule is 11-4 with a 1-4 record in last five and just lost by submission in R1
Hasan's last three fights are first or second round finishes; Gurule took 162 days to return after the Tsuruya submission loss
Hasan is 25 years old with 6 inch reach advantage and switch stance versatility; Gurule at 32 relies on FactoryX Muay Thai but lacks recent success
Hasan's eight KO/TKOs suggest power will be the path to victory in a 3 round flyweight bout

401922642.summary: Dober's recent KO wins and southpaw style create stylistic problems for Duncan despite a worse record, but age and inconsistency limit conviction.
reasons: Dober's last two wins by KO/TKO versus Duncan's recent submission losses suggest different finishing tendencies favoring Dober's style
Southpaw stance at 5'8" with 70" reach creates awkward angles; Duncan's orthodox stance and longer reach (71") mitigates advantage but doesn't eliminate it
Dober's 29-15 record shows inconsistency and losses to KO, but Duncan's only KO loss raises durability questions against Dober's finishing record
Price offers value: +135 on the fighter with recent momentum and stylistic advantages; Duncan's -160 overvalues record differential without accounting for recen

401922643.summary: Miller's submission prowess and wrestling base offer a stylistic edge over McKinney's recent struggles, but age, inactivity, and McKinney's power make this competitive enough that the underdog price lacks compelling value.
reasons: Miller has 22 submission wins versus McKinney's 9, and his wrestling base at Sussex County MMA gives him control advantages in a three-round prelim
McKinney has lost two of last three fights including a recent R1 KO loss to King Green, showing vulnerability to pressure and finish
Miller's 183-day layoff and age 43 status work against him; McKinney's height and reach advantage (73.5 vs 71) plus switch stance versatility provide real offse
The plus-180 is fair value for an aging fighter on a layoff, not a screaming underdog spot; McKinney at minus-220 carries too much chalk for a fighter showing r

401922645.summary: Mesquita's perfect record and submission prowess face a declining Chiasson, but the -220 price is steep enough to avoid parlay stacking.
reasons: Mesquita undefeated at 8-0 with 6 of 8 wins by submission; Chiasson has lost 3 straight decisions to ranked opponents
Chiasson's 35 years old with negative record momentum; Mesquita same age but peaking with 5 consecutive wins
Mesquita's submission rate (75%) and grappling pedigree (ATT) align perfectly with Chiasson's recent losses to superior grapplers
Moneyline odds justify the pick but -220 creates insufficient value for parlays given only 141 days rest for Mesquita

401922646.summary: Diaz has superior recent form and a perfect five-fight streak against a chinny opponent coming off a draw, but the matchup lacks decisive edge and Yañez's power remains a real threat.
reasons: Diaz is 5-0 in last five with three finishes; Yañez is 2-2-1 in last five with a recent draw suggesting stagnation
Yañez has lost four decisions and been KO'd twice, showing vulnerability to distance strikers; Diaz's boxing at similar height with 0.5 inch reach edge favors h
Yañez's 120-day layoff versus Diaz's 176-day rest is marginal; Yañez's KO power (12 KO wins) remains live threat preventing high confidence
No consensus line to validate price; without odds, moneyline is speculative and not a parlay anchor
